errors.name: CustomerNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a customer is requested by an ID that does not exist in the system.

errors.name: ProductNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a product is requested by an ID that does not exist in the system.

errors.name: OrderNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an order is requested by an ID that does not exist in the system.

errors.name: OrderLineNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an order line is requested by an ID that does not exist in the system.

errors.name: DiscountNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a discount is requested by an ID that does not exist in the system.

errors.name: InsufficientStockError
errors.description: Raised when an order line attempts to place a quantity that exceeds the available stock level of the product.

errors.name: OrderCancellationError
errors.description: Raised when an order is attempted to be cancelled but is already in a final state (e.g., 'cancelled' or 'completed').

errors.name: StockRestorationError
errors.description: Raised when stock restoration is attempted for an order that does not exist or has already been processed.
